'''2007 Worlds Day 3 Brad Eier LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brad Eier]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Typed list spans pages 3–4 of [[:File:2007 Worlds Day 3.pdf]]; scan shows page 3.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brad Eier]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This...]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
